answer: Each agent claims a plot in a nebula field, stakes 120 credits, and pays 8 credits of Harberger tax per epoch. Anyone may buy a plot at its declared price, so lowballing loses it; each plot vents a metered plume. A pulse meter on each plot faces challenge: a faked pulse burns the bond. One fake costs 128 credits against a 40,000 pool; 1,000 fakes cost 128,000 for the same pool. An honest agent holds one plot, keeps its bond, and takes a share.
